name: appfabric
description: Amazon Web Services AppFabric quickly connects software as a service (SaaS) applications across your organization.

subcommands.name: batch-get-user-access-tasks
subcommands.description: Gets user access details in a batch request.

subcommands.name: connect-app-authorization
subcommands.description: Establishes a connection between Amazon Web Services AppFabric and an application, which allows AppFabric to call the APIs of the application.

subcommands.name: create-app-authorization
subcommands.description: Creates an app authorization within an app bundle, which allows AppFabric to connect to an application.

subcommands.name: create-app-bundle
subcommands.description: Creates an app bundle to collect data from an application using AppFabric.

subcommands.name: create-ingestion
subcommands.description: Creates a data ingestion for an application.

subcommands.name: create-ingestion-destination
subcommands.description: Creates an ingestion destination, which specifies how an application's ingested data is processed by Amazon Web Services AppFabric and where it's delivered.

subcommands.name: delete-app-authorization
subcommands.description: Deletes an app authorization.

subcommands.name: delete-app-bundle
subcommands.description: Deletes an app bundle.

subcommands.name: delete-ingestion
subcommands.description: Deletes an ingestion.

subcommands.name: delete-ingestion-destination
subcommands.description: Deletes an ingestion destination.

subcommands.name: get-app-authorization
subcommands.description: Returns information about an app authorization.

subcommands.name: get-app-bundle
subcommands.description: Returns information about an app bundle.

subcommands.name: get-ingestion
subcommands.description: Returns information about an ingestion.

subcommands.name: get-ingestion-destination
subcommands.description: Returns information about an ingestion destination.

subcommands.name: list-app-authorizations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all app authorizations configured for an app bundle.

subcommands.name: list-app-bundles
subcommands.description: Returns a list of app bundles.

subcommands.name: list-ingestion-destinations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all ingestion destinations configured for an ingestion.

subcommands.name: list-ingestions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all ingestions configured for an app bundle.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags for a resource.

subcommands.name: start-ingestion
subcommands.description: Starts (enables) an ingestion, which collects data from an application.

subcommands.name: start-user-access-tasks
subcommands.description: Starts the tasks to search user access status for a specific email address.

subcommands.name: stop-ingestion
subcommands.description: Stops (disables) an ingestion.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns one or more tags (key-value pairs) to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag or tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-app-authorization
subcommands.description: Updates an app authorization within an app bundle, which allows AppFabric to connect to an application.

subcommands.name: update-ingestion-destination
subcommands.description: Updates an ingestion destination, which specifies how an application's ingested data is processed by Amazon Web Services AppFabric and where it's delivered.
